infra_account_linking.scope: Connections tab infrastructure cards (GitHub/Vercel/Supabase) now link real accounts the same way AI accounts do: the app installs the vendor official CLI into the per-user tools folder (GitHub CLI 2.102.0 and Supabase CLI 2.121.0 pinned with SHA-256 from the official release checksums; Vercel CLI via official npm package), opens the vendor official login in a visible window (gh auth login --web / vercel login / supabase login), then verifies through the CLI itself (gh api user / vercel whoami / supabase projects list) before storing a Vault connection. The app never receives the user password; token/API-key remains a secondary path. Live login on real Windows pending owner acceptance. HOTFIX 0.9.3: every consumer of these CLIs (connection verification in providers, GitHub publish, Vercel deploy + domain alias, Supabase project ops, git identity probe) now resolves the CLI through infra-tools (app-installed copy first) instead of bare PATH names — v0.9.2 verified connections via a bare "gh" spawn and failed with "spawn gh ENOENT" on machines where the app itself had installed the CLI (found live on the owner Windows machine 2026-10-17; the GitHub device login itself had succeeded).

account_reasoning_effort.scope: Per-account reasoning-effort SLIDER (Connections tab) mirroring each vendor’s own picker and ladder: ChatGPT/Codex stops Mặc định/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max via thread/start config model_reasoning_effort; Claude stops Mặc định/low/medium/high/xhigh/max via the official --effort flag (ultracode excluded — it is an orchestration mode, not an effort rung). Server validates per kind; the stored value is the vendor’s own token and the UI shows it next to the Vietnamese label. Gemini accounts have no vendor-documented effort mechanism and intentionally get no slider. Live effect on a real account pending owner acceptance.

media_retheme.scope: New Media Studio mode "Đổi chủ đề & giọng" (task media.retheme): keep an uploaded video’s footage, replace its whole audio with a NEW topic script + new voice + burned new subtitles. Timing windows: supplied SRT, local Whisper on the original speech, or an even deterministic split when no speech is detected. Script: project Worker model writes per-window lines against deterministic character budgets (writeRethemeScriptWithModel), or the user supplies lines / free text split deterministically across windows (splitScriptAcrossWindows). Piper voice-language guard, atempo cap 1.35, overflow reported, artifacts video-with-new-voice.mp4 + captions-<lang>.srt + retheme-report.json. LIVE VERIFIED 2026-10-17 in sandbox on the real JFK clip: Whisper windows (11), supplied VI coffee-culture script, VI Piper voice, 0 overflows, output 80.04s == source length, frame-verified burned VI subtitles on untouched footage. Model-written script path needs a verified model on the user’s machine (same gate as dub translation). Hardsub removal still NOT implemented.

media_studio_capcut_shell.scope: Media Studio rebuilt CapCut-style (0.9.7): left rail with the 9 work modes + a project media pool (real artifacts, click to preview), center stage with one main preview player, a real timeline under it (ruler, footage track, segment/subtitle track built from the selected job’s retheme/dub report segments or its captions SRT, output track, red playhead synced to the player, click-to-seek), right column keeps every existing input panel and the job queue (inline per-job players replaced by a Xem trước button that loads the job into the stage). No functionality removed; engine unchanged. Verified: contract tests (shell ids, all 9 modes/panels preserved, SRT parsing, timeline rendering) + existing media DOM-harness tests pass; served page contains the new shell. Pixel-level visual QA could not run in the sandbox (its Chromium blocks all local-network navigation) — visual acceptance is on the user’s Windows checklist.

media_director.scope: AI Director front door for Media Studio (0.9.8): ONE box — upload a video and/or type a wish, or type an idea. POST /api/integrations/media/director/plan probes the real video (readRealMediaInfo), transcribes its speech locally with Whisper when ready, and asks the project’s verified Worker model to return a strict JSON plan (buildDirectorModelCall/parseDirectorPlan in media-ai.mjs). Deterministic routing (routeDirectorPlan) maps the plan onto existing operations — quick-edit (edit or auto-captions), retheme, dub, story-from-idea — or an honest needs-input (voice file, Whisper missing, unclear). The Studio renders ONE plan card; "Đúng ý" submits the routed task AND approves it in the same gesture (the task still passes the queue machinery and carries planSummary). No verified model -> available:false with a manual 3-choice fallback, never a fake plan. Verified: unit tests for parsing/routing/contracts (test/director.test.mjs), live sandbox call returned the honest fallback (no model in sandbox); the model path runs on the user’s machine with his verified ChatGPT Worker. Explainer-style idea scripts are requested in the model instructions (hook, clear points, recap); voice quality still depends on the connected TTS engine (local Piper is synthetic).

github_work_loop.scope: Work loop for the user’s EXISTING GitHub repos (0.9.9), requested by the user ("models must fetch work from my GitHub, complete the repo, push back to GitHub and Vercel"): src/lib/github-repos.mjs — listGithubRepos via the linked gh CLI (repo list --json), importGithubRepo clones the repo into a new project workspace and binds it (settings.github via saveProjectGithub in projects.mjs), listGithubIssues + useGithubIssueAsBrief turns an issue into the project brief (the normal Founder/Council/PM flow then plans and assigns the work; workers already operate in git worktrees of the project workspace), createGithubPullRequest commits pending work (git-security checks), branches aios/<date>-<rand> off the default branch, pushes (gh auth setup-git for CLI links, token header for token links) and opens a PR via gh pr create with "Closes #N" when the brief came from an issue. UI: "Kho GitHub" panel in the Publish tab (repo list + import, binding status, issues, PR button with confirm). Vercel: the existing workspace deploy buttons work for imported projects; PR preview deploys happen through the user’s own Vercel<->GitHub integration when connected there. Verified end to end with a stub gh (API-side) and a REAL local bare git remote: list -> clone-import -> issue brief -> edit -> branch really pushed with the change -> PR url recorded (test/github-repos.test.mjs). Real-account run (his repos/issues/PR on github.com) pending his Windows test.

hardsub_cover.scope: Cover burned-in (hard) subtitles when re-voicing a video (0.9.10), one of the gaps named in the 0.9.9 summary. src/lib/voiceover.mjs hardsubCoverSegments builds an honest cover over the bottom regionPct% of the frame (default 13%, clamped 10–40; Studio offers Low ~12% / Medium ~18% / High ~26% height choices): mode blur (split/crop/boxblur/overlay) or band (translucent black drawbox), inserted into buildVoiceover BEFORE the new subtitles are burned, so new captions stay crisp. Wired into media.dub, media.retheme and media.voiceover (submit validation, handler pass-through, rendered.hardsubCover recorded in dub/retheme reports); Studio selects in the Retheme (default blur) and Voiceover (default off) panels; the AI Director routes dub/retheme with hardsubCover blur by default. This is a COVER, not inpainting — the UI and guide say so plainly; true subtitle removal/restoration is still not implemented. LIVE VERIFIED in sandbox: retheme task on a video WITH burned-in Vietnamese subtitles (the earlier JFK retheme output) + new tea-culture script + cover blur completed: report hardsubCover {mode:blur, regionPct:22, applied:true}, 0 overflows, output 80.04s == source; frame at 33s shows the old coffee subtitles fully illegible under the blur while the new tea subtitles render crisply on top and the rest of the frame is untouched (deliverables VIDEO-Che-Phu-De-Cung_JFK-Tra-Viet_che-mo.mp4 + HS-TRUOC/HS-SAU frames). Quick-edit (Concat path) does not have the cover yet.
